gloss: to despise, to scorn, to look down on

definitions.gloss: to despise, to scorn, to look down on
definitions.explanation: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect, often with contempt.

examples.japanese: {蔑|さげす}むような{目|め}で{見|み}られた。
examples.english: I was looked at with contemptuous eyes.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{貧|まず}しい{人|ひと}たちを{蔑|さげす}んでいる。
{弱者|じゃくしゃ}を{蔑|さげす}む{社会|しゃかい}は{健全|けんぜん}ではない。
examples.english: A society that scorns the weak is not healthy.

notes:
{蔑|さげす}む expresses contempt or looking down on someone.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

REGISTER:
Fairly formal or literary; the casual equivalent would be {馬鹿|ばか}にする or {見下|みくだ}す.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人|ひと}を{蔑|さげす}む: to despise someone
- {蔑|さげす}むような{目|め}: contemptuous eyes
- {蔑|さげす}んだ{態度|たいど}: scornful attitude

RELATED:
- {蔑|ないがしろ}にする: to neglect, to disregard
- {侮蔑|ぶべつ}: contempt, disdain (noun)
- {見下|みくだ}す: to look down on
